license_required.quote: A person may not practice podiatry unless licensed or exempted from licensure under this chapter.

issuing_authority.quote: The division shall issue to persons qualified under this chapter a license in the classification of podiatric physician.

name.quote: "Board" means the Podiatric Physician Board created in Section 58-5a-201.

type.quote: "Board" means the Podiatric Physician Board created in Section 58-5a-201.

umbrella_agency.value: Division of Professional Licensing, Department of Commerce
umbrella_agency.quote: There is created within the Department of Commerce the Division of Professional Licensing.

degree_required.value: Doctor of Podiatric Medicine from a podiatry school or college accredited by the Council on Podiatric Medical Education
degree_required.quote: provide satisfactory documentation of having successfully completed a program of professional education preparing an individual as a podiatric physician, as evidenced by having received an earned degree of doctor of podiatric medicine from a podiatry school or college accredited by the Council on Podiatric Medical Education

accrediting_body.quote: from a podiatry school or college accredited by the Council on Podiatric Medical Education

required.quote: if licensed on or after July 1, 2015, satisfy the division and board that the applicant: (a) has successfully completed 24 months of resident training in a program approved by the Council on Podiatric Medical Education

duration.value: 24 months or 12 months with progressive training
duration.quote: has successfully completed 24 months of resident training in a program approved by the Council on Podiatric Medical Education; or (b) has successfully completed 12 months of resident training in a program approved by the Council on Podiatric Medical Education after receiving a degree of doctor of podiatric medicine

kind.quote: resident training in a program approved by the Council on Podiatric Medical Education

interval_years.quote: The division shall issue all licenses under this chapter in accordance with the two-year renewal cycle established by rule.

required.quote: The division may require each person holding a license under this chapter to complete in each two-year period not more than 40 hours of qualified continuing professional education

hours_per_period.quote: not more than 40 hours of qualified continuing professional education in accordance with standards defined by rule as a requirement prior to license renewal

period_years.quote: in each two-year period not more than 40 hours of qualified continuing professional education

exists.quote: "Board" means the Podiatric Physician Board created in Section 58-5a-201.

regulatory_model.quote: A person may not practice podiatry unless licensed or exempted from licensure under this chapter.

credential_type.quote: The division shall issue to persons qualified under this chapter a license in the classification of podiatric physician.

is_mandatory.quote: A person may not practice podiatry unless licensed or exempted from licensure under this chapter.

title_protection.quote: for an individual who is not licensed under this chapter: (i) using the title or name podiatric physician, podiatrist, podiatric surgeon, foot doctor, foot specialist, or D.P.M.

scope_protection.quote: A person may not practice podiatry unless licensed or exempted from licensure under this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Does not meet the qualifications for licensure or renewal of licensure
disciplinary_grounds.quote: does not meet the qualifications for licensure or renewal of licensure under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Guilty of a crime which demonstrates a threat or potential threat to the public health, safety, or welfare
disciplinary_grounds.quote: is guilty of a crime which, when considered with the functions and duties of a licensee under this chapter, demonstrates a threat or potential threat to the public health, safety, or welfare

disciplinary_grounds.description: Guilty of unlawful conduct related to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: is guilty of unlawful conduct related to practice under this chapter or unprofessional conduct as defined in this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtained or attempted to obtain a license by fraud or willful misrepresentation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has obtained or attempted to obtain a license under this title by fraud or willful misrepresentation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Had a license or certification to practice in any profession subjected to disciplinary action
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has had a license or certification to practice in any profession or occupation subjected to disciplinary action which demonstrates a threat or potential threat to the public health, safety, or welfare

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in unprofessional conduct as defined in statute or rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the conduct that constitutes unprofessional conduct under Section 58-1-501

disciplinary_grounds.description: Communicating patient information to third party without consent
disciplinary_grounds.quote: communicating to a third party, without the consent of the patient, information the individual acquires in treating the patient, except as necessary for professional consultation regarding treatment of the patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Allowing name or license to be used by unlicensed individual
disciplinary_grounds.quote: allowing the individual's name or license to be used by an individual who is not licensed to practice podiatry under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing unlicensed individual to practice podiatry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: except as described in Section 58-5a-306, employing, directly or indirectly, any unlicensed individual to practice podiatry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using alcohol or drugs to the extent it impairs ability to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: using alcohol or drugs, to the extent the individual's use of alcohol or drugs impairs the individual's ability to practice podiatry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unlawfully prescribing, selling, or giving away prescription drugs or controlled substances
disciplinary_grounds.quote: unlawfully prescribing, selling, or giving away any prescription drug, including controlled substances

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross incompetency in the practice of podiatry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: gross incompetency in the practice of podiatry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully and intentionally making false statement or entry in medical records
disciplinary_grounds.quote: willfully and intentionally making a false statement or entry in hospital records, medical records, or reports

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully making false statement in reports or claim forms to governmental agencies or insurance companies
disciplinary_grounds.quote: willfully making a false statement in reports or claim forms to governmental agencies or insurance companies with the intent to secure payment not rightfully due

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully using false or fraudulent advertising
disciplinary_grounds.quote: willfully using false or fraudulent advertising

disciplinary_grounds.description: Falsely making an entry in or altering medical record to conceal wrongful or negligent act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: falsely making an entry in, or altering, a medical record with the intent to conceal: (A) a wrongful or negligent act or omission

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating requirements of Title 26B, Chapter 4, Part 2, Cannabinoid Research and Medical Cannabis
disciplinary_grounds.quote: violating the requirements of Title 26B, Chapter 4, Part 2, Cannabinoid Research and Medical Cannabis

definition_quote.value: the diagnosis and treatment of conditions affecting the human foot and ankle and their manifestations of systemic conditions, and wound debridement on the limbs and torso, by all appropriate and lawful means
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of podiatry" means, subject to Section 58-5a-103, the diagnosis and treatment of conditions affecting the human foot and ankle and their manifestations of systemic conditions, and wound debridement on the limbs and torso, by all appropriate and lawful means.

value: surgical procedures on bones of the foot or ankle
biological, enzymatic, autolytic, and mechanical wound debridement on the limbs and torso
methods_authorized.quote: an individual licensed as a podiatric physician under this chapter may perform: (a) a surgical procedure on a bone of the foot or ankle; and (b) biological, enzymatic, autolytic, and mechanical wound debridement on the limbs and torso

anatomical_scope_upper_boundary.quote: an individual licensed as a podiatric physician under this chapter may perform: (a) a surgical procedure on a bone of the foot or ankle

amputation_authorized.quote: An individual licensed as a podiatric physician under this chapter may not perform an amputation proximal to Chopart's joint.

anesthesia_authority.quote: does not administer anesthesia, except for a local anesthetic

ankle_surgery_authorized.quote: An individual licensed as a podiatric physician under this chapter who meets the requirements described in Subsection (4) may only: (a) treat a fracture of the tibia if at least one portion of the fracture line enters the ankle joint

ankle_surgery_residency_requirement.quote: graduated on or after June 1, 2006, from a three-year residency program in podiatric medicine and surgery that was accredited, at the time of graduation, by the Council on Podiatric Medical Education

ankle_surgery_facility_requirement.quote: An individual licensed as a podiatric physician under this chapter may not perform a surgical treatment on an ankle, on a governing structure of the foot or ankle above the ankle, or on a structure related to the foot or ankle above the ankle, unless the individual performs the surgical treatment: (a) in an ambulatory surgical facility, a general acute hospital, or a specialty hospital

systemic_disease_treatment_excluded.quote: the diagnosis and treatment of conditions affecting the human foot and ankle and their manifestations of systemic conditions

systemic_disease_local_manifestations_in.quote: the diagnosis and treatment of conditions affecting the human foot and ankle and their manifestations of systemic conditions

value: American Board of Foot and Ankle Surgery
board_certification_body.quote: is board certified in reconstructive rearfoot and ankle surgery by the American Board of Foot and Ankle Surgery

podiatric_assistant_authorized.quote: a medical assistant working under the indirect supervision of a licensed podiatric physician, if the medical assistant: (a) engages only in tasks appropriately delegated by the licensed podiatric physician

podiatric_assistant_supervision_level.quote: a medical assistant working under the indirect supervision of a licensed podiatric physician

wound_debridement_authorized.quote: biological, enzymatic, autolytic, and mechanical wound debridement on the limbs and torso, if the podiatric physician is certified by the American Board of Wound Management as a Certified Wound Specialist Physician

corrective_footwear_exemption.quote: persons who fit or sell corrective shoes, arch supports, or similar devices, to the extent their acts and practices involve only the fitting and selling of these items
